_README: Map of recipe slug -> imageUrl. Leave a slug's value as an empty string to
skip it (the recipe keeps whatever imageUrl it already has in the DB).
1. On Unsplash, find a photo. Click the download arrow -> Copy image
address. You'll get a URL like:
2. Paste it as the value for the matching slug below.
All hosts in next.config.ts -> images.remotePatterns are accepted, so
Unsplash, iStock previews, Pexels, Pixabay, Amazon, iHerb, and Thrive
URLs all work. Self-hosted paths (like /recipes/foo.webp pointing at
/public/recipes/foo.webp) also work and don't need an allowlist entry.
